<thought>The spectrum shows a classic isotopic envelope decreasing roughly 9 % per additional neutron, matching the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 %) multiplied over ~8‑9 carbon atoms. This pattern uniquely indicates carbon. No other element’s distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) is evident. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
